property.name: evaluated standard deviation

experiment.comment: The XML contains the LBV data without radiation correction. This way, any arbitrary radiation heat loss model can be used for modeling these experiments.

Too few data points in the data series; therefore, no appropriate fitting could be carried out with Minimal Spline Fit. An experiment-type-characteristic standard deviation, 1 cm/s, was assigned to std_fit.
